verdict.outcome_rationale: This was a genuine agent-fault failure and the verifier's FAIL is correct [1]. The task asked for cities where NEXTDC added additional built capacity in calendar year 2023, with Digital Realty data-center counts listed in ascending order of MW added [2], and the reference derivation yields only Melbourne (3 MW added, 2 DLR sites) and Sydney (4 MW added, 4 DLR sites) [3][4]. The NEXTDC announcement explicitly says Sydney and Melbourne had built capacity added while Port Hedland merely opened with 0.5 MW of built capacity—a new-site opening, not an addition to existing built capacity [5], which the reference solution deliberately excludes [6]. The agent did read those development-activity lines and correctly extracted DLR counts of 2 for Melbourne and 4 for Sydney from the supplemental portfolio table [7][8], but it still submitted Port Hedland - 0 ahead of the two correct cities [9] and concluded Port Hedland belonged in the answer set [10], so its final answer does not match the required ordered list [1][3].

evidence.claim: The verifier assigned binary_reward 0 and reported the agent's answer as incorrect because it included an extra Port Hedland entry not in the expected ordered list.
